title: Formal Warning for Leaving Work Without Completing Assigned Responsibilities
message:
Dear Aun,

This announcement serves as a formal warning regarding your decision to leave the workplace without completing your assigned work and responsibilities.

You were expected to complete the assigned task(s) before leaving for the day. However, you left without completing the required work and without obtaining prior approval or properly communicating the situation to your supervisor. This behavior is unacceptable and has negatively affected the workflow, team productivity, and project commitments.

Employees are expected to take full responsibility for their assigned tasks and complete them within the agreed timelines. If there is a legitimate reason that prevents you from completing your work, you are required to communicate this to your supervisor and obtain approval before leaving.

Please be advised that any repetition of this behavior will be treated as a serious disciplinary matter. Continued failure to complete assigned responsibilities, leaving work without authorization, or failing to communicate with management may result in further disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment.

You are expected to take this warning seriously and demonstrate immediate improvement in your work discipline, responsibility, and communication. Any future incident of a similar nature may result in termination without further warning, subject to applicable company policies and employment terms.

Regards,
Muhammad Osama
Project Manager

title: Break Timing Announcement
message:
Hello Elipse Team,

Please note the updated office break schedule, effective immediately:

Monday to Thursday & Saturday: 1:30 PM – 2:30 PM
Friday: 1:00 PM – 2:15 PM

In addition, employees may take a 15-minute prayer break for Asr and Maghrib prayers.

Please note that no other breaks are permitted during working hours unless they have been approved in advance by your Project Manager or Team Head.

We appreciate everyone's cooperation in adhering to these timings to help maintain a productive and efficient work environment.

Thank you.
